copy.headline: Lone unbeaten Utah seals spot in Big 12 title game win win over TCU
copy.caption: Devon Dampier threw a 68-yard touchdown pass before halftime and an 85-yard clincher in the fourth quarter as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17 for its 17th straight victory, clinching a spot in the Big 12 championship game.
